aboutText: Jim's Test & Tag is Brunswick's go-to provider for test and tag services, helping businesses maintain OHS/WHS compliance. With over 1,000s of jobs completed and 10,000+ five-star reviews, our police-checked team ensures your workplace is safe. Serving Melbourne and regional areas, we specialise in electrical testing, fire safety, and emergency lighting. Request a free quote today to safeguard your business.
servicesText: We offer a wide range of testing services to keep your business compliant. From electrical test and tag to fire equipment testing, our team covers all aspects of workplace safety. Trust Jim's Test & Tag for reliable service in Brunswick.

services.title: Electrical Test & Tag
services.desc: We test and tag all electrical equipment to ensure compliance with Australian standards, keeping your workplace safe from electrical faults.

services.title: Fire Equipment Testing
services.desc: Regular testing of fire extinguishers, blankets, and alarms to maintain fire safety compliance and protect your property.

services.title: Emergency Lighting Testing
services.desc: We inspect and test emergency exit lights and backup systems to ensure they function during power outages or emergencies.

services.title: Smoke Alarm Testing
services.desc: Comprehensive testing of smoke alarms and detectors to meet legal requirements and provide early warning in case of fire.

services.title: RCD & Safety Switch Testing
services.desc: Testing and certification of safety switches to prevent electrical shocks and ensure rapid response to faults.

services.title: First Aid Kit Services
services.desc: Supply and restock workplace first aid kits with essential items, ensuring you're prepared for minor injuries.
